snippets.snippet_text: "Non-US merchants and affiliates are required to complete a Form W-8, which includes some basic information about you, such as your name, tax classification, and country of residence. The purpose of the Form W-8 is to establish your identity and status as a non-U.S. person."
"Payouts may be blocked or paused if we are missing required tax information. Funds cannot be transferred externally, but payments will continue to be received."

"If you meet all the criteria below for the previous calendar year, you will receive a 1099-K from Lemon Squeezy: The account is based in the US (or has completed a Form W-9) More than $20,000 USD in gross volume from sales of goods or services in the previous calendar year"
